import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();stage=root/"evidence/LRN-09/stateful-continuous-ppo-20261006"
v=json.loads((stage/"verification.json").read_text())
for name,digest in v["artifact_sha256"].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((stage/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
docs=[root/p for p in ["ENG.md","README.md","delivery-status.md","learning/rl/README.md","docs/tickets/26-continual-matrix-imitation-ppo-and-bio-inspired-protocols.md","docs/tickets/43-stateful-continuous-ppo.md"]]+list(stage.glob("*.md"))
links=0
for p in docs:
 for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",p.read_text()):
  target=target.split("#",1)[0]
  if not target or re.match(r"[a-z]+:",target):continue
  assert (p.parent/target).exists(),str(p)+":"+target
  links+=1
d=json.loads((root/"docs/requirements-status.json").read_text())
assert sum(r["status"]=="passed" for r in d["requirements"])==89
assert [r["id"] for r in d["requirements"] if r["status"]=="specified"]==["TSK-11","OPS-05"]
ref="../evidence/LRN-09/stateful-continuous-ppo-20261006/verification.json"
assert all(ref in r["evidence"] for r in d["requirements"] if r["id"] in ["COR-08","LRN-01","LRN-09"])
print(json.dumps({"relative_links_validated":links,"artifact_hashes_validated":len(v["artifact_sha256"]),"requirements_passed":89,"requirements_total":91}))
